Homeowners Associations (HOAs), nonprofit boards of directors, condominium associations, and municipal committees must legally verify a quorum before passing resolutions or holding binding votes. Here is how board secretaries track attendance and establish proof of quorum in Google Meet.
Quorum & Board Attendance Tracking
Official board meeting attendance export with excused absence tags

Defensible Proof of Quorum: Save board secretaries hours of manual recordkeeping. Attendance Tracker generates timestamped records of every director's arrival time, departure time, and total active minutes for your official meeting minutes.
The Legal Importance of Quorum in Virtual Meetings

Under most state non-profit corporation acts and HOA bylaws (such as Robert's Rules of Order), if a board votes on a budget, vendor contract, or assessment without a verified quorum present, the vote is legally voidable. Virtual meetings introduce unique challenges:
Directors Arriving Late or Dropping Early: A director who disconnects before a vote may cause the board to lose quorum without the chair noticing.
Documenting Excused Absences: Board minutes must distinguish between unexcused absences and directors who submitted formal notices of absence.
Official Record Archiving: Board secretaries need clean, audit-ready spreadsheet records stored permanently in the organization's Google Drive.
How Attendance Tracker Streamlines Board Governance
1. Live In-Meeting Quorum Count
Open the Attendance Tracker panel in Google Meet. See the exact count and list of active voting members in real-time, complete with arrival timestamps.
2. One-Click "Excused Absence" Tagging

When board members RSVP'd with regrets ahead of the meeting, the export modal allows the secretary to check "Excused" next to unmatched invitees. The generated report labels them as Absent (excused) rather than unexcused.
3. Annual Board Meeting Series Tracking

For monthly board meetings across the fiscal year, Attendance Tracker links all sessions by the Google Calendar recurring event ID. You can see cumulative annual attendance percentages per trustee or board director.
Ideal for:
HOA & Condo Association Boards: Verify member quorum for annual general meetings (AGMs) and monthly trustee votes.
501(c)(3) Non-Profit Boards: Document trustee attendance for annual IRS Form 990 governance reporting.
School Boards & Parent-Teacher Organizations (PTO/PTA): Track parent committee attendance and quorum requirements.
Academic Senates & Faculty Councils: Maintain official attendance logs for university senate legislative votes.
